guide-workshop: Welcome to the workshop. Help Sam build. Tap the yellow play button to begin. Tap the speaker to hear this again.
guide-workshop-done: Your workshop missions are finished. You can stop here, or choose a mission to build again.
guide-intro: Meet the sounds. Tap each letter to hear its sound. When you are ready, tap Ready to build. You can go back to the workshop at any time.
guide-sound: Listen, then choose the letter for this sound.
guide-word: Tap a letter, then a space. You can also drag a letter into a space. Put the sounds in order.
guide-check: When you are ready, tap Check answer. Tap Show me for help, or Skip for now to move on.
guide-again: Let us listen and try again.
guide-together: Let us build this one together. Listen to the sounds, then tap Continue together.
guide-show: Listen to the sounds in order.
guide-skipped: We can practise that another time.
guide-power-ready: The workshop is ready. Tap Test the lights to turn on the workbench lights. Or tap Done for now to finish.
guide-power-done: The workbench lights are on. You finished this mission. Tap Done for now when you are ready to stop.
guide-seat-ready: Sam has a mat for the seat. Tap Test the seat to see Sam sit. Or tap Done for now to finish.
guide-seat-done: Sam sat on the mat. You finished this mission. You can hear the sentence, or tap Done for now to finish.
guide-save-error: Your progress could not be saved. Tap Retry save, or ask a grown-up for help.
